name: Small Bowl with Decoration of Two Boys on the Interior and a Stylized Lotus Arabesque on the Exterior
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；mid 16th-early 17th century；Porcelain with interior decoration painted in underglaze cobalt blue and with gold enamel painted on a red enamel ground added to the exterior at a later date; with spurious underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Da Ming Yongle nian zhi" within a single circle on the base.
